Hi! Per @timbeiko encouragement...would love to spend 5-10m to present some reth-related slides, how we intend to interface with ACD etc, as well as leave some time for Q&A!

I'd like to discuss a couple of questions:

- Is https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7672 included in devnet9?
- Should system address `0xff..fe` be removed after an EIP-4788 system call if it was previously existing but empty? There are quite a few scenarios in execution-spec-tests that have that. Right now it is not in geth (and in erigon) because [SubBalance](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/v1.13.0/core/state/state_object.go#L419), unlike [AddBalance](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/v1.13.0/core/state/state_object.go#L407), doesn't touch the address when the transferred value is 0.
